mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of FEDFUNDS below 4.0% instances, or returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of UNRATE above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days, as higher unemployment rates suggest weakening labor market conditions and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%, or revert to positive within 30d.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) above their 3-month moving averages signal robust demand growth, amplifying corporate earnings and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: both proxies increase in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC >0.03 over any 3-month window, or returns not significantly positive when both proxies increase.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days due to higher borrowing costs compressing corporate margins.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly negative during FEDFUNDS >4.5% in tightening cycles, or revert to positive within 60d.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply) above 110.0 for 3 months indicates expanding production capacity, lowering inflationary pressures and fostering positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive in 3 out of 4 months with INDPRO above 110.0, or IC <0.03 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 crosses above 11233.5 (current level), it signals a surge in economic activity, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate growth.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 crosses above 11233.5, or revert within 30d.

mechanism_narrative: Opposite movements in UNRATE (down) and PAYEMS (up) in the same month indicate improving labor market conditions, boosting corporate profits and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases while PAYEMS increases in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over 3-month window, or returns not significantly positive when UNRATE down and PAYEMS up.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in INDPRO below 110.269 (current value) signals overcapacity, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as market anticipates peak and slowdown.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 110.269 in late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 110.269 in late-cycle, or revert within 60d.
